query.description: The search query. Supports operators like site:, -, filetype:, inurl:, intitle:.

sources.description: Result sources to include. Include 'alexandria' to discover matching catalogue tools for free alongside web results.

categories.description: Optional Firecrawl vertical categories. 'gov' cannot be combined with other categories.

limit.description: Maximum results per source type. Default 8.

tbs.description: Optional time filter: qdr:h/d/w/m/y, a custom range like cdr:1,cd_min=MM/DD/YYYY,cd_max=MM/DD/YYYY, or sbd:1 to sort by date.

include_domains.description: Restrict results to these hostnames. Mutually exclusive with exclude_domains.

exclude_domains.description: Exclude results from these hostnames. Mutually exclusive with include_domains.

tool_detail.description: Detail level for returned Alexandria tools. 'full' includes each tool's input contract (options/response/examples) so it can be executed via firecrawl.alexandria without another lookup.

domain_tools.description: Also return catalogue tools whose provider matches the domains of the web results. On by default when 'alexandria' is among the sources; set false to disable.
